en.title: Keycode Tester
en.description: Press any key on your keyboard and instantly see its key, code, keyCode and location. A handy reference for web developers.

faqs.question: What is the difference between key and code?
faqs.answer: key is the character produced (e.g. "a" or "A"), while code is the physical key location (e.g. "KeyA"), independent of layout.

faqs.question: Do I need to install anything?
faqs.answer: No. Everything runs in your browser and no data is sent anywhere.

faqs.question: key 和 code 有什么区别？
faqs.answer: key 是产生的字符（如 "a" 或 "A"），code 是物理按键位置（如 "KeyA"），与输入法布局无关。

faqs.question: 需要安装任何东西吗？
faqs.answer: 不需要。所有功能都在浏览器本地运行，不会上传任何数据。
